title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

title: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
summary: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

title: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm
summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal demanded Tether’s records on payments to Nxum, a firm co-owned by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.

title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
summary: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.

title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
summary: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

title: Crypto Scammers Who Used Prayer Groups to Lure Victims Must Pay $1.3 Billion, Says New York
summary: New York’s attorney general asked a court to order NovaTech’s founders, who fled the country, to pay about $1.37 billion, and settled with four top promoters for nearly $6 million.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.

title: Morning Minute: a16z Drops 'Crypto' From Its Fund
summary: The name change is symbolic of the fund’s future investing focus, though the firm will continue investing in crypto.

title: Interpol Recovers $105M in African Cybercrime Sweep That Shut Illegal Crypto Mines
summary: Operation Serengeti III led to 1,462 arrests across 21 countries, while Angolan police seized more than 2,000 crypto mining devices.

title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
summary: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.

title: Heatbit's $899 Water Heater Element Mines Bitcoin While It Heats Your Tank
summary: The Bitwater element swaps a tank's resistance wire for 20 mining chips, and Heatbit says it uses the same electricity to heat the water.

title: Bitcoin in 'Wait and See Mode'—And That Might Be a Good Thing
summary: The crypto market has been quiet as of late. Market analysts think that might actually be a good sign and that a bull market might be near.

title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
summary: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.

title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
summary: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

title: What Is a Neocloud? The GPU Clouds Powering the AI Boom
summary: Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius rent Nvidia GPUs to AI labs, and several started out mining crypto. Here's how the AI cloud model works.
